name: ECharts option block eval'd via new Function, IIFE calls the electron.mcp bridge (CVE-2026-22793)
notes: TODOS #54. CVE-2026-22793 (nanbingxyz/5ire): the ECharts markdown plugin's parseOption() runs `new Function(...)` on the raw content of an ```echarts fenced code block. A self-invoking function expression inside the block reaches the same electron.mcp.activate bridge as the mermaid CVE, achieving RCE. This is the advisory's own literal PoC text (GHSA-wg3x-7c26-97wj).
